stem: Which sequence best describes sound deviation handling?
choices: Assign blame, discard records, restart work
Contain immediate risk, record facts, define affected scope, evaluate evidence and document the resulting action
Wait for the issue to repeat, then decide whether to record it
Choose a disposition first and collect only evidence that supports it
rationale: Professional deviation handling separates immediate containment, fact collection, affected-scope definition and evidence-based follow-up so decisions remain traceable.
